veranderings.voor: en dan swel dit dikker op
veranderings.rede: 'Opswel' already means to get bigger and thicker, so 'dikker op' is redundant and unidiomatic; 'swel op' is also the form the next block uses.

veranderings.voor: warmte nodig soos enige ander groen plant
veranderings.na: warmte nodig, soos enige ander groen plant
veranderings.rede: Without the comma 'soos enige ander groen plant' can read as a fifth item or an example in the list; the comma marks it as a comparison with the whole clause.

vlae.teks: Later druk 'n klein stingel boontoe by die saad uit.
vlae.rede: The lesson calls the plant's stem 'stam' everywhere else (blocks 1, 2, 5 and the measuring list) but 'stingel' here; a Grade 4 learner may take these for two different parts. Whether to align the term is a subject-term decision, so it is flagged rather than changed.
